PreToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -Eq '(DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE|rm -rf /|git push.*(-f|--force).*main)'; then echo 'BLOCK'; echo '⚠️ Destructive command blocked.'; fi

PostToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE" | grep -q '\.py$'; then ruff check --fix "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null; elif echo "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tsx|ts)$'; then bun eslint --fix "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi

TaskCompleted.command: echo '📋 QA gate: run tests + lint before PR'
